entities.name: Rieko Nakagawa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Rieko Nakagawa  was a Japanese children's literature writer and lyricist. Her first work, Iyayaen, was published in 1962, and she published over 30 books since then. She had won multiple awards for her works, including the Kikuchi Kan Prize.
